CheckTitle: Okta user passwords have been changed within the rotation window
Description: This check reports active users whose password has not changed within the configured window (365 days by default), or for whom no password change is recorded at all.
Risk: A password unchanged for years is one that has had the **maximum possible exposure to credential breaches elsewhere**, since reuse is common and breach corpora accumulate over time. While forced frequent rotation is no longer recommended practice, an unchanged credential of this age combined with weak or absent MFA is a meaningful indicator of an account worth attention.

Code.Other:
1. Prefer breach-driven rotation over calendar-driven: enable **breached password detection** so a credential is reset when it is known to be exposed
2. Where a maximum password age is required by policy, configure it under **Security > Authentication policies > Password**
3. For the accounts flagged here, confirm a strong MFA factor is enrolled — that matters more than the password age
4. Consider moving the account to passwordless authentication with FIDO2
5. Reset passwords for any account appearing in a breach corpus regardless of age

Recommendation.Text: Drive password resets from breach detection rather than a calendar, ensure flagged accounts have a strong factor enrolled, and move suitable accounts to passwordless FIDO2 authentication.
